name: overpower
description: A build methodology for coding agents: adaptive process weight, tool scouting, preflight checks before code, verified delegate runs, durable state, change-impact gate.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code mapping for overpower vocabulary (see using-overpower → Vocabulary):
- skills mechanism → the Skill tool.
- delegate → Agent: subagent_type "coder" for op-implementer / op-reviewer briefs (paste agents/<name>.md plus the task text into prompt), "explore" for read-only search, "plan" for a plan critique. A delegate result counts only with its returned result.
- asking the user for a decision → AskUserQuestion, 1-4 questions, 2-4 options, recommended first.
- guard hook → none on Kimi: follow the scope rule yourself; reviewing-changes checks it.
- Use Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, FetchURL, WebSearch and MCP tools by their real names.

interface.shortDescription: Size the task, check the plan against the code, build test-first, review what a fix changes
